description: Calculate how much each of 6 Czech banks will lend (or whether a requested amount gets approved) from household income, expenses, debts and property, using each bank's own credit methodology (DSTI, DTI, LTV, living costs, recognition of self-employed, pension, rental and other income). No personal data needed: ages and amounts only.

applicants.description: 1–4 applicants (household members who will be borrowers).

age.description: Age in years (or year of birth).

annual_revenue.description: Self-employed: annual revenue from the last tax return (row 101/113), CZK.

annual_tax_base.description: Self-employed: annual tax base from the last tax return, CZK.

avg_monthly_revenue.description: income_type=osvc_paus (flat tax): average monthly revenue in CZK. Required for osvc_paus (or annual_revenue, divided by 12).

business_industry.description: income_type=osvc_paus: line of business (banks apply industry margins to revenue).

flat_expense_rate.description: Self-employed flat-rate expenses as a fraction: 0.4, 0.6 or 0.8.

flat_tax_band.description: income_type=osvc_paus: monthly flat tax actually paid in CZK, or band number 1–3. Omit to derive it from revenue.

income_type.description: Main income: employee = employment; osvc_vydpausal = self-employed with flat-rate expenses; osvc_skutecne = self-employed with actual expenses; osvc_paus = flat tax (paušální daň); sro = company owner; rental; dpp/dpc = side contracts; pension; parental = parental allowance; ppm = maternity; dividends; vysluha = service pension.

months_employed.description: Months at current employer (text with a unit like "2 roky" or "18 měsíců" is accepted).

months_in_business.description: Months in business (self-employed: osvc_paus, osvc_vydpausal, osvc_skutecne). Omit if unknown.

net_income.description: Net monthly income in CZK (for employees and pensions). For self-employed use annual_revenue and annual_tax_base; for osvc_paus (flat tax) avg_monthly_revenue.

paid_full_prev_year.description: income_type=osvc_paus: was in the flat-tax regime for the whole previous year.

pension_type.description: For income_type=pension: old-age, disability, widow's, orphan's.

residence.description: Residency: Czech, EU/EEA, stable third country, other.

secondary_income_type.description: Optional second income of the same applicant (same codes as income_type).

secondary_net_income.description: Net monthly amount of the secondary income, CZK.

children.description: Number of dependent children (counted as 6–15 years old). For precise living costs send children_ages instead.

children_ages.description: Ages of dependent children, e.g. [3, 9]. Overrides children.

credit_card_limits.description: Sum of credit card limits, CZK.

existing_debt_balance.description: Outstanding principal of all existing loans, CZK (DTI limit).

fixation.description: Rate fixation period: 1R, 3R, 5R, 7R or 10R (years). Numbers 1/3/5/7/10 are accepted too. A bank that does not offer the fixation is listed as unavailable (compare) or rejected with fixation_offered=false (max-loan).

housing_cost.description: Monthly housing cost that continues after the purchase (e.g. rent), CZK.

investment.description: Buy-to-let / third or further residential property (LTV 70 %, DTI 7).

loan_payments.description: Monthly payments of all existing loans and leasing, CZK.

married.description: Applicants are spouses with joint property (SJM).

property_type.description: Flat, house, cooperative flat, land, recreational, commercial.

property_value.description: Property price in CZK. Without it the result is the income-based maximum only.

purpose.description: Purpose: purchase, refinancing, construction, renovation, non-purpose (American mortgage), settlement.

region.description: Prague, other larger town, small municipality (affects living costs).

requested_loan.description: Specific loan amount to assess (approved yes/no per bank); needs property_value (or valuation), otherwise only the maximum is returned with an input_warnings note. Omit to get the maximum per bank.

term_years.description: Repayment term in years ("30 let" or "360 měsíců" accepted).

name: calculate_max_mortgage
title: Kolik mi která banka půjčí
